description: Set environment variables on an App or project, for API keys or external service config. A registered App's variables are written at its provider, which holds the only copy: on Vercel the change reaches the App with a new production deployment of the live files (counted as a deploy), on Cloud Run with a new revision. Use service_id to scope to a specific service in multi-service projects.

project_id.description: The project ID to set variables on.

service_id.description: Optional service ID for multi-service projects. Scopes env vars to a specific service.

vars.description: Key-value pairs of environment variables to set.

name: set_env_vars
